diagnosis: The check C3 passed in all rollouts because the model defaulted to a fixed-price offer structure (offer_method set to 'fixed-price') instead of the open-market methods specified in the shared facts. This default setting allowed the check to pass even though the model did not have access to PF3, which specifies the offer method as a fixed-price offer structure.

C3.why: The shared materials do not fix the transaction format or price, while PF3 changes offer_price_cents_per_share to exactly 825 and offer_method to a fixed-price offer structure.
